title: Branched Bending in Finite-Volume Hyperbolic Manifolds
summary: We define branched bending deformations as deformations supported on a piecewise totally geodesic complex of $(n-1)$-dimensional faces meeting along $(n-2)$-dimensional branching loci. These are a generalization of bending deformations, as introduced by Johnson and Millson. We give a lower bound on the dimension of the (infinitesimal) deformation space supported on a branched bending complex, and in doing so generalize a result of Bart and Scannell.
